items.title: Phase 4: the organ check joins the paragraph that gives its reason, and the bile case says what it is
items.my_version: Benjamin Brown (Digestive Health Solution) is the only source for this phase. If even the "Nuclear Option" failed, you can cross the microbiome off the list. The problem is likely an organ that isn't working right, or environmental toxicity or your brain's false danger signals (those two are Phase 6, below). So check your organs, starting with your pancreas: if it doesn't make enough digestive enzymes, called Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency, you'd test for that with Stool Elastase, and treat it with high-dose enzymes. Or is it your bile? If too much of it reaches your colon, you get diarrhea, called Bile Acid Diarrhea. Get a SeHCAT test for it, and if it comes back positive, take bile binders.
items.before: So check your organs (Brown). If your pancreas doesn't make enough digestive enzymes, called Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency, you'd test for that with Stool Elastase, and treat it with high-dose enzymes. If it's Bile Acid Diarrhea, the test is SeHCAT, and the treatment is bile binders.

items.my_version: Start by re-seeding your gut with Davis's high-dose "SIBO Yogurt", which you ferment at home for 36 hours. He picked its bacteria for what they do: L. reuteri heals your gut lining and boosts oxytocin (the "love hormone"), and L. gasseri makes bacteriocins, natural antibiotics that kill SIBO.
